items.q: ” So she has them sing until they sound just like Ella [Fitzgerald], or they sound just like Billie Holiday], or they sound just like Tony Bennett.

ctx.x: And she kicked ass. And, of course, she has her singers imitate. She says, “When you can imitate enough people, then you can find your own self in there somewhere.” So she has them sing until they sound just like Ella [Fitzgerald], or they sound just like Billie Holiday], or they sound just like Tony Bennett. That may be one month. Then the next month they have to sound like somebody else. By the time they’ve done that through six or seven singers, all of a sudden they find out that they’ve got their own shit.…
